name: THEIA
fullName: Thrombolysis for Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
population: n=70, ≥18, NIHSS n/a, ≤4.5 h from severe vision loss
teachingPoint: THEIA was neutral (adjusted OR 1.1, 95% CI 0.07-18.39, p=0.95; underpowered) — CRAO thrombolysis remains unproven; do not present it as evidence-supported outside trials.

name: TenCRAOS
fullName: A Randomized Trial of Tenecteplase in Acute Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
teachingPoint: No demonstrated visual-recovery benefit; serious safety concerns. This is an evidence summary, not a treatment recommendation.
